summary: Emits fixed session event message ID 337 through the shared driver-data table when the race is active and the track condition is valid. Guarded by the race-active flag dword_7D0308 and the track-condition state flt_7CF3C8; when both allow it, a local record v0 is populated with message ID 337 and placeholder driver/time arguments by DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion, then that record is inserted into the session table at flt_5EA618 by InsertDriverTableEntry. Structural twin of the function DisplayMessage0x11c, which emits message ID 284 through the same guarded path.

operations.description: Run the body only when dword_7D0308 is non-zero and flt_7CF3C8 is not 0.0; otherwise do nothing.
Populate the stack record v0 with message ID 337 and placeholder driver indices and time via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v0, 337, -1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0).
Insert the populated record v0 into the shared driver-data table at flt_5EA618 via InsertDriverTableEntry.
Void return once the guarded table insert completes.
